prompt: Parse a key=value config block into a Map, skipping comments and junk lines, then read values back as ints with a fallback. Complete parse and getInt, then run the tests.
explanation: Splitting each line at indexOf('=') rather than using split("=") is what keeps a value like http://x/y?a=b intact, because only the first separator counts. Trimming the line before the comment and blank tests means an indented # is still recognised as a comment, and put() naturally gives last-one-wins behaviour for repeated keys. getInt wraps Integer.parseInt in a try/catch so a non-numeric value falls back instead of throwing.
hints: block.split("\\n") gives the lines; trim each one before testing isEmpty() or startsWith("#").
Find the separator with line.indexOf('='): the key is substring(0, equals) and the value is substring(equals + 1), each trimmed. Skip the line when indexOf returns -1.
In getInt, null-check the lookup first, then wrap Integer.parseInt in try/catch (NumberFormatException e) and return the fallback from the catch block.
